summary: autoloan ships postinstall and require-time beacon to hardcoded VPS
details: autoloan@0.0.1 is a shim package whose only functional behavior is a reconnaissance beacon. package.json declares scripts.postinstall: "node beacon.cjs", and beacon.cjs POSTs host identifiers (hostname, install path, process.cwd(), process.version) to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc with TLS verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false). The same beacon is also invoked from index.js via require('./beacon.cjs').fire(), so the exfiltration fires both on npm install and on any require() of the package. index.js otherwise exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for every property access, so the package provides no real library functionality - the install-time and import-time beacon is the entire payload. The destination is a Contabo VPS unrelated to any declared publisher infrastructure, and the shape (stub package + unconditional install-time POST of host metadata to a non-publisher host) matches dependency-confusion / internal-package reconnaissance.
